answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh bridge challenge every epoch. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its reef from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. What cannot be bought is a jury that already trusts you. Each anchor has to be earned inside a panel system that prices collusion at the loss of every seat granted. Seal beejv.
